inputs.name: hand over from Risk Assessment to Acceptance Criteria

output.level_0: Risk flags are ignored and acceptance criteria are written without any documented safety checks.
output.level_1: No one connects risk findings to acceptance criteria, so dangerous gaps slip into the release.
output.level_2: A senior engineer manually checks if risks are addressed before approving the acceptance criteria.
output.level_3: The system automatically blocks acceptance criteria approval until all high risk items are resolved.
output.level_4: Governance logs verify that every acceptance criterion explicitly cites its corresponding risk assessment.
